articleTitle: Intelligent Control of Electric Machine Drive Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: In this paper the novel approach based on an intelligent control and monitoring for the redundant and energy-efficient electric machine-drives is presented. Different control optimization strategies are studied for the case of stochastic and determined perturbations. Principals of the state variables fuzzy-logic control and artificial neural networks (ANN) application are suggested.

articleTitle: Energy saving in the scalar control system of an asynchronous electric drive
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Currently, more than 2000 hoisting mechanisms in the Novolipetsk Steel, including a considerable proportion of conveyors. Most conveyors are characterized by intermittent mode (cyclic duration factor is from 25 to 40 percent), frequent starting and braking, wide range of the load variation, which means that the motor can operate in underloaded condition, and therefore with less efficiency. In this article following task was performed: Simulation of a typical scalar drive control system with vectorterm adjustment of the stator current of the inductor motor risk factors. This control system will significantly reduce the stator current consumption from the grid when non-nominal load by maintaining the angle between the stator current and the rotor flux linkage unchanged at 45 degrees.

articleTitle: Advancements in Electrical Machines Design Brought by the Modular Construction
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: In the last years, the developments in the field of electrical machines are speeding up more and more to keep in line with the rapid industrial advancements and fast growing requirements. The most emerging targets of the electrical machines designers are cost reductions, efficiency and reliability improvements, etc. One of the approaches to achieve these is the modular construction of the electrical machines. In the paper a survey is made on the progresses brought by this approach in the field of electrical machines. Also, some typical examples of the modular construction possibilities of some electrical machines are included.

articleTitle: Synchronous reluctance motor: Design and experimental research
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: In this paper, the results of development and experimental research of a synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) SRM160M6ie2 are presented. The design of the machines was carried out in JSC “NIPTIEM” using a technique based on the use of finite element modeling of the magnetic field. Experimental research of the main characteristics of the synchronous reluctance electric motor powered by electric network and frequency inverter, is carried out in the testing center JSC “NIPTIEM”. Comparison of the characteristics SynRM and induction motor (IM) 7AVER180M6ie2 development of JSC “NIPTIEM” showed advantages of SynRM in terms of energy, weight and overall dimensions. On the basis carried out research, are formulated the basic directions of works on development and industrial use of SynRM.

articleTitle: Ways of Increase Energy Efficiency of Electric Drives Sucker Rod Pump for Oil Production
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: In the article proposed methods for determining the power characteristics of an electric drive of a sucker rod pump under conditions of a cyclic loading and insufficient counterbalancing. Analytic dependencies are proposed that allow determining the operational values of efficiency and power factor $\cos\varphi$ under cyclic loading. The operating modes of the electric drives of pumping units can be optimized with the help of these calculations. Thus, the specific energy consumption can be reduced for pumping oil production and the costs of oil producing companies on energy purchasing.

articleTitle: The Production Possibility of Permanent Magnet High Speed Electric Generator Rotors
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: At present there has appeared to be a tendency of high speed permanent magnet electric generators application. Rotor rotation frequency of such generators amounts to 100 000 rpm. Large axial thrusts, capable to destroy a machine act upon permanent magnets at such rotation frequencies. This paper deals with the replacement possibility of traditional rotor bandage from high-tensile steel for the bandage made by winding method from composite material. Different composite materials: glass fibre plastic and carbon-filled plastic were analyzed. It is noted that to use carbon-filled plastic is most appropriate.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Protected Low-Cost Voltage-Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper considers the design of low-cost voltage source inverter of the fan of air-conditioner. It was suggested to use the cheapest drivers and implement short-circuit protection using current transformers. The signal of the current transformers drives the protection circuit and provides the response time of the short-circuit protection of 1 us. The measurement circuit provides enough data for overcurrent, phase loss and thermal protection and the algorithms of detection of these faults are explained. The performance of the proposed solution was examined at the experimental setup and proved its reliable operation.

Author Keywords: current transformer, low-cost drive, short-circuit protection

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Thyristors Switched Capacitors during Reactive Power Compensation of Dynamic Load
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper study the performance of new scheme of thyristors switched capacitors TSC during the reactive power compensation for induction motor. The paper explains the principle of operation of the new TSC scheme. The control algorithm of the TSC during reactive power compensation of dynamic model (induction motor) is developed. Simulation model using MATLAB/SIMULINK is developed to illustrate the active action of the TSC during reactive power compensation in the starting period of induction motor.

articleTitle: Sensorless energy-efficient sucker-rod pump control system
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article describes sensorless energy-efficient control system of the sucker-rod pump, which is based on polished rod load calculation from electrical parameters of prime mover asynchronous motor. The sensorless method of computation and stabilization of dynamic liquid level in the well is proposed. The principles of energy efficient control system in sensorless mode for the sucker-rod pump via regulation dynamic liquid level in the well are shown. From the side of prime mover the Kalman filter algorithm is used to observe the necessary variables for electromagnetic torque calculation. The motor torque makes it possible for polished rod load and dynamic liquid level estimation. The vector system of electric drive allows to provide energy efficient laws of control. The efficiency of proposed sensorless control system for the sucker-rod pump were confirmed by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Self-sensing Control of a Switched Reluctance Drive Using Voltage Pulse Injection
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper considers robust and reliable method of self-sensing control of the switched reluctance motor drives at zero and low speeds based on voltage pulse injection. A voltage pulse is injected into inactive phases of the motor to measure motor phase inductance. Clarke transformation is then used to form an inductance vector. Finally, a PLL is used to estimate rotor speed and position. The proposed method was verified by means of simulation.

articleTitle: Taking Into Account Nonlinear Properties of Switched Reluctance Machines in Electric Drive Control Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The problem of creation the switched reluctance drive control system based on the simplified computer model, taking into account non-linear switched reluctance motor properties is considered. It is shown that the control algorithm based on piecewise linear approximation of magnetization curves does not provide a constant phase current and torque on an interval of tooth overlapping. When forming of the controlling signals in model the Miller's normalized magnetization curve is used. It represents family of real magnetization curves as dependence of flux linkage on phase current and the angular position of a rotor. For high speed area the dependence of phase switch on angle from the preset values of current and speed providing decrease of current and torque pulsations by 3-4 times is received.

articleTitle: Research, Development, Manufacturing and Application of Energy Efficient Electric Motors
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The main research areas carried out by PJSC “NIPTIEM” in the direction of improving the efficiency of electromechanical energy conversion are considered in the article. Electromechanical converters of perspective types are considered. The possibilities of the enterprise in the field of R &D are shown.

articleTitle: Reference Trajectory Optimization for an Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: In this paper a novel approach for the industrial robot reference trajectory optimization is presented. The proposed method ensures that predefined accuracy is met, data complexity is reduced and transfer time from an external device to the robot's controller is minimized. Various approximation algorithms for the desired motion trajectory are considered. In order to determine the most suitable one quantitative criteria is proposed, enabling high performance of an industrial robot while limiting deviations from the given trajectory. The experiment was conducted using collaborative industrial robot YuMi (ABB). It was shown that the proposed Q criterion of optimality provides deterministic rules and ranking for choosing an appropriate approximation algorithm.

articleTitle: The Research of Frequency-Controlled Synchronous Drive Transient Processes
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: A mathematical model is presented and characteristic transient processes in synchronous motors of variable frequency drives associated with load acceptance and shedding, changes of power supply voltage and frequency and drives speed adjusting are considered. The results can be useful in studying the features of synchronous drive adjustment as well as in the formation of requirements for reconstruction of synchronous drives of gas compressor units at compressor stations and pump units at oil pumping stations of main pipelines.

articleTitle: Experimental Estimation of Frequency Response Functions of Precision Servo Drive Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of experimental estimation of the frequency response functions of precision electric drive systems. Typical examples of such systems are axes of telescopes that are part of space monitoring systems. Some methods of frequency response estimation based on experimental data such as empirical transfer function estimation (Fourier transform), averaged Welch periodograms, estimation and time-frequency analyses of impulse response are considered. The impact of distortions and nonlinearities such as Coulomb friction, torque ripples and cogging torque, discretization noise and others on results of experimental estimation of frequency response functions is considered. Experimental conditions which can reduce the impact of nonlinearities are defined. The switched controller is used to limit the angular velocity and angle of rotation and to provide the permanent sign of the angular velocity for reducing the impact of Coulomb friction. The applicability of the considered approaches to the estimation of the frequency response functions for precision electric drive systems has been approbated on mathematical model of electric drive with a two-mass load using MATLAB.

Author Keywords: system identification, nonlinear distortion, Fourier transforms, permanent magnet machines, electric drive.

articleTitle: Improvement of Switched Reluctance Motor Performance Using Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: In this paper, the results of studies on the formation of the magnetic system of the rotor of a switched reluctance motor using Monte Carlo optimization method. The optimization criterion is chosen - the minimum of electromagnetic torque ripple. A comparative analysis of electromagnetic torque ripple for two variants of a rotor design is made. Experimental studies were carried out to obtaining the dependence of torque on rotor position for two variants of a rotor design: preproduction model rotor obtained as a result of optimization and rotor, designed without optimization.

Author Keywords: design for experiments, torque, Monte Carlo method

articleTitle: Power electrical drive Power-Hardware-in-the-Loop system : 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Power Hardware-in-the-Loop (PHiL) system for electric drives application based on power converter with Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) -based control system which realizes in real time model of converter, motor and mechanism is discussed. Two PHiL structures are under consideration. Difference between both of them is shown. Test results obtained in the PHiLs with Converter Under Test (CUT) control system are presented in the paper. Proposed PHIL is intended for converters testing and for their operating modes studying. The PHIL repeats electric drive instantaneous current and angular velocity.

articleTitle: Anti-Sway Full Order State-Feedback Control of the Overhead Crane with Variable Rope Length Using Luenberger Observer
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a full order state-feedback control system for a payload carrying overhead crane trolley capable of eliminating the payload swing. In order to estimate the payload swing angle and its angular velocity a Luenberger state observer was designed. Both control system and observer were designed according to linearized model of “trolley-payload” mechanical system. To improve the transients shape an observer adaptation technique was proposed, which takes into consideration variable rope length. We then compare the designed system with the speed cascade control system, which uses three-stage acceleration and braking. The simulation results indicate the efficiency of the designed system in terms of payload swing elimination in case of present initial swing angle.

Author Keywords: automatic control motion control state-space model

articleTitle: Analysis of Mechanical Power Flow in an Electric Drive Operating Under Vibration Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper discusses the analysis of mechanical power flow in an electric motor drive operating under variation of conditions. The drive system vibration generates the oscillation in the supplied active power which can reduce performance of the system and increase the actual load on the shaft. It is shown that the vibration damper installation significantly decreases the oscillations in mechanical power flow on the motor shaft and improves characteristics of the system operation. The paper provide analysis of two models of the electric drive installed on the platform - the system which is quipped with vibration dampers and without.

articleTitle: Single-Loop Control System for Energy Storage Device in the Frequency-Controlled Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article considers a single-loop current control system for the energy storage device in a frequency-controlled electric drive. The energy storage device includes a bidirectional DC-DC converter, which is based on two fully controllable switches, and supercapacitors block. The problems of synthesis of the current controller are considered in the article, the properties of the current control system are analyzed. In conclusion, the simulation results of the energy storage system as part of a frequency-controlled electric drive are presented.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Adaptive Force Control System in Springy Gears of Force Compensating Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The synthesis methodology of adaptive electromechanical force compensating system (EFCS) of load lifting mechanisms (LLM) with springy gears at considerable change of parameters of control object was offered. Analytic formulas for parameters determination of adaptive control device at change of mass of a load and rigidity of mechanical gears have been received. The results of mathematical modeling of effort changing processes in a mechanical part of a system and with application of the synthetic correcting device (CD) have been given.

articleTitle: A Model of an Ultra -Fast Moving Magnet Actuator for Power Switches in Medium Voltage Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The development of smart grids requires fast circuit breakers, where conducting contacts are separated by actuators. This paper describes the investigation of an electrodynamics moving magnet linear actuator with FEM and an analytical model. Geometry parameters define flux tubes, which yield reluctances for a magnetic equivalent circuit. Its solution allows to calculate a mean force and potential accelerations of this moving magnet actuator. The analytical model is evaluated numerically, calculating Pareto fronts for acceleration and actuator volume. The results are verified by FEM simulations and one demonstrator, also including transient operation.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Servodrive Control System for Exact Tracking in the Extended Speed Range
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The possibility to extend the speed range of direct servodrives with PMSM via field-weakening realization is one of the perspective ways to increase equipment productivity without additional capital expenditure. In the study a novel approach on the optimization of PMSM dynamic field-weakening control for servodrive is presented. Using of the presented enhanced dynamic model control improves the conduction losses while preserving the exact tracking precision. Simulation results showed significant reduction in conduction losses -in order of 30% in comparison with conventional dynamic field-weakening-depending on the motion profile.

articleTitle: An Approach to Forecasting the Elements Technical Condition of Standalone Generator Propulsion Complexes
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article considers the approach to forecast the technical condition of a ship's electric propulsion system area, based on analyzing the time-series of working capacity degree with the help of autoregressive integrated moving average model, which helps to forecast the predicted value of the quantity taking into account external factors such as operating conditions and equipment deterioration.

articleTitle: Development of the optical method for measure the wire feed speed in the electron beam additive manufacturing process
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The need of measuring the wire feed speed in the process of electron-beam additive manufacturing instead of measuring the drive rollers rotation speed is proved. Factors that have a negative effect on the result of the technological process are listed. A new method for measuring the wire feed speed, based on image processing from a photo-detector array, is proposed. The possibility of implementing this method with using industrial technical solutions, applied in human interface devices, is shown. The transient characteristics of wire speed control channel, obtained experimentally with the help of raw input technology, have been studied. The workability of this method and the possibility of its application for building a feedback sensor for the wire feed speed control loop in additive technology are substantiated.

Author Keywords: additive manufacturing wire feed speed control

articleTitle: Identification of Permanent Magnets of Electrical Devices Based on the Solution of Inverse Problems of Magnetostatics and Heat Transfer
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of an improved method for identifying permanent magnets of electrotechnical devices, in particular, slotless electric machines with permanent magnets located on the rotor. The method is based on the solution of inverse problems of magnetostatics and heat transfer by finite element method. The initial information is the values of the radial component of the magnetic induction in the air gap region, the family of magnetization characteristics of permanent magnets and the corresponding to them temperatures, as well as the design and dimensions of the electric machine. Calculation of the magnetic and thermal fields is performed by the finite element method. The method allows determining the magnetic and thermal state of permanent magnets installed in an electric machine at a relatively small computational cost. Examples of method implementation are given. The method can be used for the design of other electrotechnical devices in the designs of which permanent magnets are used.

articleTitle: An Effective Current Limitation Algorithm For Servo Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of limiting the effective current value in a closed loop control system of electric drive on the basis of known nominal parameters of the motor and measuring the instantaneous value of current at the interval of work with the maximum current. Simulation in MATLAB/Simulink results show that utilization of the proposed method makes it possible to operate at allowable temperature over a wide range of velocity using maximum currents at short intervals.

articleTitle: The Controllable Eddy Current Brakes with Permanent Magnets: Basic Concept
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The use of permanent magnets (PMs) in eddy current brakes (ECBs) increases efficiency because no energy is consumed by an excitation system of the brake. The main drawback of this case is no possibility to change braking torque of the ECBs in operating mode. This paper proposes a way for torque control in the ECBs with PMs. The torque control is realized by means of mechanical movements of an inner salient pole core that provides small reluctance in “On” position and very high reluctance in “Off' position. The basic concept and approximate torque calculations have been done.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Comparison of Standard and Articulated Trolleybuses: Case Study
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The two main types of trolleybuses running in Riga city are non-articulated or standard type řkoda 24TR and articulated řkoda 27TR. On its merits, 27TR is devised to be applied when the demand for the carriage of passengers is higher. However, there might be situations when 27TR runs at the route when the demand for transportation is low, i.e. 27TR carries the amounts of passengers able to be carried by 24Tr. It becomes disadvantageous in electrical energy saving point of view. This paper compares the energy consumptions of both trolleybus types for various loads which are caused by passengers. Idealized trolleybus motion simulations were carried in Matlab/Simulink environment and in each case the same distance was travelled at the same time period. The percentage differences by which articulated 27TR traction drive consumes and regenerates more energy, comparing to standard 24TR carrying the same passenger amounts, are calculated.

articleTitle: Improving Point-to-Point Motion Profile for a Direct Servo Drive under Constraints
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Optimization in control of electric drives is hardly possible without considering hardware constraints of the system. In order to prevent precision or even system stability loss for servo drives working in exact tracking mode the motion profile should be formed in a way that all of reference values of drive variables do not exceed the constraints. The paper considers third order point-to-point transport motion profile. As the result of a constraints analysis a modified motion profile is proposed. The trajectory generation algorithm utilizes a mathematical model of the drive and linear interpolation of the limiting characteristics in the electromechanical plane. The simulation results show that the time required for a point-to-point motion can be reduced by the order often of percent depending on the parameters ofthe power drive system and technological limits.

articleTitle: Investigation of Transients in a Common DC Link of Parallel Connected Power Converters
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of current oscillations in the common DC link of the power converters operated simultaneously. The parallel operation of the inverters may cause the huge current oscillations between capacitors of the common DC link, add extra losses and decrease lifetime of the capacitors and the fuses. Two methods of the solution to the problem were considered. First is to add extra inductance between DC link capacitor banks, and second is to use PWM timers shift. Experimental results are provided for extra inductance, and simulation experiments were performed to prove the efficiency of the PWM pattern shift.

articleTitle: Research of the Power Composite Switch Output Current-Voltage Characteristic with Using the Spice-Model
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The paper considers the problems of application of the modern semiconductor switches in high-power high-voltage schemes. The alternative topologies of the energy efficient power switches for using in the power converters of medium and high voltages have been presented. The power composite switch Spice-model for investigation its current-voltage characteristics (I-V curves) has been proposed. The I-V curves obtained in LTspice simulation environment have been compared to the experimental characteristics.

articleTitle: Dynamic Field Model of Brushed DC Motor for Electric Drive Systems Research
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The study is devoted to the technology of brushed DC motors dynamic modes simulation. The aspects of implementation of the high-speed field dynamic model of a collector-type machine for electric drive systems research on the basis of modern software are considered. The proposed technology allows to combine the speed of chain models and the accuracy and universality of field models, and take into account non-traditional features of the electric machine design.

articleTitle: Design features of brushless electric motor for advanced aircraft fuel pump
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The main goal of this work is to develop and research of the brushless electric motor for advanced aircraft fuel pumps. The article presents the design of the brushless electric motor and experimental study of a model in different modes. Testing of the prototype was carried out under the influence of both high and low temperatures, which showed its high reliability and efficiency with minimum weight and size indicators. In addition, a developed computer model showed a high accuracy and convergence with the experimental results. The efficiency of the proposed electric motor for fuel pumps is proved on the basis of the developed computer models and experimental studies.

articleTitle: Using Proton Irradiation with Initial Energy over 10 MeV to Improve Turn-off Time of High Power IGBT and FWD
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Authors research a possibility of using accelerated protons with initial energy over 10 MeV to improve turn-on and turn-off properties of high-power IGBT and FWD and demonstrate a method to produce fast IGBT and FWD for voltages 1700V adapted for operation in power electronics at frequency in the range of 20-30kHz.

articleTitle: Flux Estimation Algorithms for Double-Fed Induction Motor Drive Field-Oriented Control
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The presence of additional freedoms to control along the rotor circuit in double-fed induction motor makes it possible to use simpler algorithms of the flux linkage estimation for sensorless control implementation which in the paper are presented. Two models of flux linkage observers are presented-flux linkage observer by using rotor voltage values for estimate flux linkage and current model of observer. The stability margins of proposed observers are determined and the evaluation of stability to changing parameters of double-fed induction motor is given. Results of sensorless control system theoretical research by Matlab software simulation results are confirmed.

articleTitle: The mathematical model of an induction machine in terms of the skin effect in the rotor and the saturation of magnetic circuits
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The mathematical model of a deep-bar induction machine has been improved by taking into account the stator iron loss, the skin effect in the rotor winding and the saturation of the magnetic circuits along the main magnetic flux paths and leakage fluxes. The mutual inductances of the windings and leakage inductances are represented as nonlinear functions of the moduli of the corresponding currents flowing in these windings. Stator iron loss are taken into account using an additional winding located on the stator and having a common mutual inductance, resistance and nonlinear leakage inductance with other windings. The skin effect in the rotor winding is taken into account by its representation by two R, L branches connected in parallel. The simulation results of starting and loading modes for a deep-bar induction motor with 1700 kW rated power and 6 kV stator nominal voltage are presented.

articleTitle: Calculation of the external characteristic of a switched-mode power supply
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The paper studied the switched-mode power supply output filter with bridge topology to determine its operating modes. Variable ratios and algorithms are proposed for calculating the external characteristic, taking into account the limitation in cyclic current. The adequacy of the calculated variable ratios and algorithms were confirmed using mathematical modeling and testing by experimental sampling a high-voltage power supply.

articleTitle: Observer-Based Control System Design of High Performance Motion System with Parallel Kinematics
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper deals with a multi-axis control system of a precision air bearing motion stage with parallel kinematics. The air bearing motion stages offers high precision positioning resolution and accuracy due to frictionless motion, usage of high resolution optical encoders and temperature stable materials. The achievement of a nanometer positing resolution requires the highest feedback resolution and servo stiffness. A design of the extended state observer combined with a position sensor processing is presented for a multi-axis motion control in a plane. The proposed observer structure is presented in a form of a third order acceleration observer. The application of the observed acceleration disturbance helps to increase the servo stiffness. The simulation and experimental results confirms the efficiency of proposed solution. There are achieved 20 nm positioning resolution and 50 nm tracking error at a velocity of 0.5 mm/s using the optical encoder with a period of 20 μ m.

articleTitle: Upgraded Electric Drive of a Finishing Stand in the Hot Rolling Mill 2350 of the Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article considers the results of modernization of the main electric drive of a finishing stand of a hot rolling mill. A functional diagram of the new microprocessor control system of the electric drive is presented. Distinctive features of this system are distinguished. With the help of the new mill diagnostics system transient processes of the stator and rotor currents of the drive synchronous motor are obtained. Transient processes reflect the various operating modes of the electric drive provided by the operation of the drive control system.

articleTitle: Carrier Amplitude Control for Neutral Point Balancing in a Multilevel Active Voltage Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Article deals with a neutral point balancing in a multilevel active voltage rectifier. An algorithmic capacitor voltage disbalance compensation method is proposed for multilevel neutral point clamped converter of multi-engine system with a common DC-link. Simulation of the system with unbalanced load of converter levels with and without compensation was performed which showed the absence of the capacitors voltage disbalance in system with proposed capacitors voltage disbalance regulator. The analysis of power quality factors provided allows to conclude that the system meets the requirements of the existing standards to the emission of harmonic components of phase currents and provides power factor correction.

articleTitle: Signal-based Intelligent Diagnostic Method for BLDC Motors
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This article describes an intelligent signal-based diagnosis method. It makes possible to see the difference between true object malfunction and changing its operating mode. As experimental results for brushless DC motors (BLDC) the dependence of wavelet transformation measurement coefficients on the characteristic scales of a serviceable and faulty motor under different loading modes has been revealed. Based on the received information a neural classification network, which makes it possible to reveal the current state of the object has been developed. It is established that all types of mother wavelet can be used for this method realization. The validity of the theoretical calculations and model adequacy are confirmed in the large volume of pilot studies.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Required Voltage for Improved MTPA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: MTPA method improve the efficiency of IM, however penalizes the dynamic, due to the need of magnetizing machine to produce torque. Dynamic of torque during magnetization strongly depend on current constraints as well as on voltage constraints when the machine operates at high speeds. This paper analyses the estimation methods of required voltage when current command is changed. Three approaches are proposed. They are: discrete backward model of IM, discrete complex PI-controller and continuous analytical solution based on transfer function of system. The obtained methods made it possible to realize algorithm with high dynamic response taking into account current and voltage constraints.

articleTitle: Positioning Control System Design Considering Mechatronic Module Torque Loop Response Time
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The study is devoted to the position control system synthesis for electromechanic modules with a specified dynamics and taking into account the motor torque loop time response. Mathematical models in the state equations form, characteristic polynomials, and transfer matrices for systems with position regulators are obtained. It makes possible to ensure the system dynamics corresponding to the Bessel polynomials with an acceptable bandwidth value. Synthesis and analysis of performances are carried out using the MathCAD's symbolic mathematics. The principles of regulators fixed adjustment providing the position control system robustness in presence of the mechanics inertia variation are developed.

articleTitle: Development of Actuator For Spacecraft Docking Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The paper presents a developed structural scheme for an electromechanical actuator of spacecraft docking devices. Such design will provide for minimum weight and dimensions parameters of the system at its maximum reliability due to the application of the following: torque dual-speed motor, electromechanical controllable damper operated under low rotation frequencies, as well as the application of an actuator three-circuit follow-up system ensuring the fastest response time. The paper also presents a mock-up specimen of the electromechanical actuator for docking devices manufactured according to the proposed technical solution. The presented electromechanical actuator will make it possible to obtain increased accuracy and reliability of the work of the docking devices of space vehicles due to reliable and easy software control. One of the main ways to modernize the actuator is to reduce the mass, by creating more energy efficient electromechanical dampers.

articleTitle: Application of Acceleration Feedback in Multi- Coordinate Force Compensating Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: machine control; electric drives; rotors; induction motors; torque; energy conservation; electric motors; power convertors; optimisation; position control.

articleTitle: Models and Simulation in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article considers one of the possible generic models of the processes of human cognitive and creative activity. In terms of this model, some problems of higher technical education are formulated and their solutions are suggested. In the educational process, it is first and foremost necessary to constantly use and improve the natural human ways of cognition and creation - the goal-setting and motivational basis, motor skills, sensorics, and the brain. Practice of the formation of heuristic and formalized models, speech, writing, drawing, physical training, collecting and analyzing the results of nature experiments and model verification should permeate every discipline constantly.

articleTitle: Significance of Non-Active Power in Energy Efficiency of Electric Drives
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The paper deals with consumption of total electric power in electric drives: active (kW) and non-active (kvar) regarding reactive and distortion power. Based on more confirmed references, regulations and measurements, the state of consuming non-active power in electric drives is analyzed. The measurements on different ways show that consumption of non-active power is not negligible. The questions about active and reactive power are almost elaborated, but distortion power is usually not measured and paid. However it is bad stimulation for more using power electronics. Non-active power must be produced, transmitted and distributed too. The problem becomes heavier with modest possibility to storage electric energy, i.e. produced electric energy is mainly immediately consumed.

articleTitle: Inductor Motors Characteristics Research At Dynamic Braking
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article considers the inductive motors running excited by permanent magnets at a braking mode, accomplished by the complete cut-off from the external source. The mode basic characteristic is a mechanical one. There are also considered the method and calculation algorithm of the characteristic through vector diagrams taking into account the thermal field impact on the machine permanent magnets with the help of mathematical apparatus of the experiment design theory.

articleTitle: Model Test of Hybrid Electromagnetic Suspension for High-Speed Vacuum Transport
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article presents the concept and test results of the hybrid electromagnetic suspension for levitation of highspeed vacuum transport. The given approach allows minimizing the energy consumption needed for vehicle levitation system. The model tests for the proposed system have been performed and proved the prospective application of the hybrid electromagnetic suspension for levitation system.

articleTitle: The Development of a Virtual Learning Kit in the Discipline ”Mathematical Modeling of Systems and Components of the Electric Drive”
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Approaches for developing of virtual learning kit for preparing electric drives engineers are offered. Modeling of semiconductor rectifiers is sufficiently studied at present. However in many scientific papers used for training of electric drive specialists this problem is presented in its own unique way. In this paper, known approaches of semiconductor electric drives digital models developing will be summarized. And authors' vision of this problem, that is (taking into consideration) of as many as possible special features of complete units and electric drive system in whole, is offered. Proposed to consider variant differs in that developing of the kit in Matlab software actual power components and their digital prototypes are directly conformed. Also the problem of based on the principle of sampling method thyristor pulse-phase control system digital model developing will be considered. The reason for developing of such a learning kit is to improve quality and level of specialized in electric drive educational programs graduates.

articleTitle: Control Algorithm for an Unwinding Machine’s Electric Motor on a Rebar Production Line
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: One of the key factors leading to product quality improvement by reducing the imperfect product percentage on rebar production lines lies in modernization of electric motors' control system. Known technical solutions for those systems were developed without consideration of their effect to the quality of the rebar. One of the important quality factors characteristic of the rebar is depths of notches on it. It is established that the electric motors that drive the rebar line's units can affect the depths of notches on the processed rebar wire. The objective of this paper is the development of the unwinding machine's electric motor control system algorithm which would decrease imperfect product percentage caused by the deviation of the depths of notches on the wire from desired values. The objective was achieved based on analytical methods for solving algebraic problems, computer modeling methods and statistical processing of the experimental data consisting of depths of notches values and the line's electric motors' load torque alteration values. Novelty of the paper is in proposing new control algorithm for the unwinding machine electric motor. That algorithm stabilizes rebar wire tension on a specified level at the inlet of profile stand by the means of alteration of the breaking torque that is produced by the unwinding machine's electric motor. That, in turn, decreases depths of notches deviation. As a result of the implementation of this algorithm there was obtained decrease in rebar percentage that has depths of notches out of allowable range from 7.2 % to 1.1 %.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Reference Trajectories for Energy Efficiency Position Electric Drives
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Asymmetric reference trajectories for acceleration, speed and position were synthesized so that the current heat losses proportional to the motor dynamic torque are minimal and taking into account speed and acceleration constraints. A real-time motion profile implementation option was suggested. The correctness of analytical expressions for optimal trajectories calculation was verified using mathematical simulation and experimental study.

articleTitle: Using Robot and Electric Drive in Fall Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The global aging phenomenon has motivated active research in human fall injuries. The fall prevention has hence become a popular topic in health informatics. An effective fall prevention paradigm could save millions of people from injury and avoid considerable casualties. Through comparison studies, detail-oriented simulations, and pragmatic field tests, an effective fall prediction method has been developed by authors. The finding is presented in this paper. Three techniques for fall prediction are discussed in this paper. A comparison technique to mimic the traditional stateless fall prediction techniques, along with an algorithm using artificial neural network, was first implemented in authors' previous paper. Then a robotic scheme was developed to simulate human fall by transplanting a proven fall prediction paradigm for humanoid robots with controlled electric drive systems to human subjects. Due to its simulation nature far from the human fall scenarios in reality, the robotic paradigm has obvious limits in real world applications. It was also used more like a reference framework for our last scheme. Eventually we built the third approach that eliminated the above limitation. The third approach is elaborated in this paper. Our test and simulation have proved its pragmatic superiority over other two approaches, along with vast majority of traditional paradigms.

articleTitle: Linear Electromechanical Actuator for Low Frequency Oscillations Excitation in Oil Tubing String
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Elastic waves excited in the oil layer are used to intensify oil production. In order to pass from the source above the well to the layer, it is necessary to use low-frequency waves with a low attenuation coefficient. To transfer the highest power into the layer, the waves must be in the mechanical resonance with oil tubing string. The comparative analysis of four types of low-frequency linear electromechanical actuator is presented. The most effective design for use under conditions of high mechanical load is selected. The analysis of dynamic characteristics is carried out by macro modeling. The actuator prototype for increase oil productivity of well is designed and tested at an oil field.

articleTitle: Prospects for the Development of Educational Programs in Mechatronic and Electric Drive Systems for Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of approaches to the formation of a curriculum for the master's program in agrarian mechatronics, corresponding to the requirements of the Russian and European higher education standards. The concept of “mechatronics” is considered. The analysis of input disciplines in technical university Ilmenau (TU Ilmenay) and Platov South-Russian State Polytechnic University (NPI) (Platov SRSPU(NPI)) which produce master classes in this direction is made. Their correspondence and the possibility of integrating the curricula are established. The relevance of the introduction of mechatronic systems in agriculture and the need for training of specialized specialists is presented. The structure of the curriculum on the direction of 15.04.06 “Mechatronics and Robotics” the orientation “Agrarian mechatronics”<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>, containing six modules of disciplines is proposed. The interrelation of the introduced disciplines is shown.

articleTitle: Method of Robust Control for Mechatronic Systems with Digital State Controllers and Observers
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: We propose a method of synthesizing robust digital modal control systems with state observers based on generating dynamic system characteristics within the areas of parametric robustness. Further, low sensitivity of the system to changes in controlled object parameters is ensured by the minimal phase character of the complex controller's transfer function, while low sensitivity to changing parameters of the controller itself is ensured by excluding positive feedback in both control and adjustment circuits.

articleTitle: Optimum Design of Linear Switched Reluctance Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The article describes a variant of designing of linear switched reluctance generator, optimized under criterion of energy efficiency. It is proposed to optimize using the genetic algorithm within calculating the generator's magnetic field by the finite element method. The mathematical model of linear SRM is described, and also the results of the simulation are presented.

articleTitle: Review of Unmanned Aircraft System Technologies to Enable Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) Operations
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: The need to develop and deploy Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) aerial vehicles has intensified over the last decade. As the demand for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) has increased, so too has the regulations that surrounds the industry. Strict regulations are currently in place but differ from country to country. Due to these regulations BVLOS innovators have been posed the task of exploring the means of operating flight missions with the UAV out of the sight of the pilot. Autonomous flight capability is not only fundamental to BVLOS operations for UAS but also likely to have a significant impact on the future development of passenger carrying autonomous aircraft. This review explores the technologies that have been developed to date that enable BVLOS applications. BVLOS flight operations have the potential to open a huge area of commercial opportunity however, there remain many concerns about the current capabilities of UAS to detect and avoid manned and unmanned airborne hazards that may pose a significant safety risk.

articleTitle: Modelling a Vector Controlled Induction Motor in Simulink
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: A workflow to model an electric motor drive system with a control system in Simulink is presented. The induction motor (IM) is modelled using an equivalent circuit based on the space-vector theory in the stationary reference frame. The motor is controlled using the classical indirect vector control implemented in the rotor flux reference frame that utilizes an ideal converter and modulator. The presented system model can be used as a basis for teaching electrical drives, particularly in the context of learning by doing where the goal is to learn new things using a practical approach. The following approach links the space vector theory to practice and helps students to understand the importance and the value of the theory.

articleTitle: Perspectives and Peculiarities of Spae Vector Modulation Implementation in Precision Electric Drives with Induction and Synchronous Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Article deals with issues of space vector modulation-based control algorithms implementation in multi-level inverters for induction and synchronous machines. Analysis of output current pulsations and provided by them electromagnetic torque ripple was performed and their relationship with parameters and algorithm of modulation was established. Inefficiency of amplitude spectrum analysis for torque ripple minimization was shown. Electromagnetic torque ripple minimization method based on selection of corresponding switching trajectories with taking into account the variation of load was presented.

articleTitle: Topology Selection of a High-Speed Synchronous Electrical Machines For Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: This paper presents the topology selection of the high-speed synchronous electrical machines for prospective unmanned aerial vehicles. The main novelty is the use of the amorphous magnetic materials as a stator core material, which allows achieving an efficiency over 96 %. A multidisciplinary design algorithm was proposed, and several topologies were calculated. The rotor dynamics analysis and the mechanical rotor strength calculations were performed. The optimized topology were selected by using genetic algorithms. In the result, the eddy-current losses in permanent magnets were reduced by 300 % compared with the initial variant. A cooling system was proposed, and thermal calculations were made. To confirm all theoretical conclusions, a full-sized 5-kW 60,000rpm experimental sample with a power-to-mass ratio of 5 kW/kg and an efficiency of 96.4 % was created. It was found that the use of amorphous magnetic materials allows the loss reduction in the stator magnetic core by 400-600 %.

articleTitle: Optimum and Quasioptimum Control of Direct Current Positional Electric Drive by Criterion of Minimum Electrical Losses at Weakening of Magnetic Flux
publicationTitle: 2018 X International Conference on Electrical Power Drive Systems (ICEPDS)
abstract: Base on the example of the DC motor with magnetic flux weakening the position electric drive optimal profile is considered. The criterion of optimization is a minimum of electric losses in armature winding. The comparative analysis of triangular, parabolic and quasioptimum trapezoidal profiles is carried out. Parameters of the modes “minimum minimorum” and a zone of rational change of acceleration for a variation of movements time are determined. For optimum “parabolic” profiles at magnetic flux weakening there is a limit value of speed determined by the relation of values of a current limitation to load torque. Parabolic profiles can be replaced with some form of their approximation - quasioptimum profiles which can provide execution of the same given relocation for the same time at 12... 24% bigger losses.
